verdict.rationale: The docs describe OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for server-to-server access without an end user, suited to an agent. Each credential can only reach the routes of the scopes granted to it, and the docs explicitly advise granting only what the integration uses (least privilege). Credentials can be revoked from the Internet Banking credentials panel. Missing for 10: a documented catalog showing how granular the scopes are, expiry/TTL options, the ability to edit scopes after creation (they are immutable), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
